mapper.select: select user_uuid from creation_comment where id = #{commentId} and status = 1 limit 1
select user_uuid as authorUuid, content from creation_comment where id = #{commentId} and status = 1 limit 1

select pc.id, pc.post_id as postId, pc.user_uuid as userUuid, u.nickname as nickname, pc.content, pc.like_count as likeCount, pc.reply_count as replyCount, case when l.id is not null then true else false end as likedByMe, pc.created_at as createdAt from creation_comment pc left join user u on pc.user_uuid = u.uuid left join creation_like l on l.creation_type = 'COMMENT' and l.creation_id = pc.id and l.user_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and l.status = 1 where pc.post_id = #{postId} and pc.status = 1 order by pc.created_at asc
mapper.update: update creation_comment set like_count = like_count + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{commentId} and status = 1
update creation_comment set like_count = case when like_count > 0 then like_count - 1 else 0 end, updated_at = now() where id = #{commentId} and status = 1
update creation_comment set reply_count = reply_count + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{commentId} and status = 1
update creation_comment set reply_count = case when reply_count > 0 then reply_count - 1 else 0 end, updated_at = now() where id = #{commentId} and status = 1
